limits: Mosaic contains seasonal changes, photographed shadows and residual seams; not a change map or measured albedo.
SPG SHAP7 125K source differs from archive GEO 4M geometry. Native detector sampling is independent of atlas density but not ground-truth uncertainty.
SPC SHAP5 archive release is later than VIRTIS pipeline v1.1; angular mapping retains ambiguity withholding.
Atlas density is a mean area-to-texel measure, not uniform source resolution or GPU residency.
No inference of universally smooth frame rate from retained node counts or still images.
Inspected close zoom shows triangle seams, stretched texture and rejected patches around the neck; photographic transfer reaches 68.70 m display-to-source displacement.

browser.checkout: Managed 67p-dataset-upgrade worktree on the recorded base plus the hashed changes. Server bound to 127.0.0.1:4214.
browser.assetBinding: Final captures use the freshly restored 69-file package whose byte counts and hashes are in delivery.restoration. Dataset switch captures precede the final text-only caption publication; geometry and texture bytes match.
